Review Date

Section 2 - Purpose
(1)
This Policy provides for the recognition of student organisations by the University and establishes core principles for University recognition of student organisations.

Section 3 - Scope
(2)
This Policy applies to any student organisation that meets the criteria in this Policy.

Key Decisions

Section 7 - Definitions
(9)
For the purpose of this Policy:
The University: La Trobe University.
Recognised Student Organisations: a student-led organisation recognised under this Policy.
